units: <cite ref="Gittin 30b:12">Gitt. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דק׳</he> the quantity being defined.

<cite ref="Ketubot 43a:2">Keth. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>לא שביק אינש מידי דק׳ … דלא ק׳</he> a man will not forego the claim of a definite quantity, and demand something undefined (requiring appraisement); a. e.—Pl. <he>קִיצֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 88a:5">B. Bath. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>דק׳ דמיה</he> (Rashb. <he>דקָיְיצֵי</he>) when its price is fixed; <he>דק׳ דמיהו</he> when their prices are fixed.
